claim_fence: Standard claim fence applies (F-PIP-2; claims taxonomy per DEC-081).

conventions.value: [decimal with 40 significant digits, binary64]; an interval is {lower, upper}
conventions.exact_zero: "0": known exactly, or a residue below 1e-60 SI snapped to zero (README)
conventions.member_end_force: node-on-element end actions in the member's local frame (x chord, y y_reference projected, z = x cross y)
conventions.section_action: j-side (+x face) section action in the local frame at the five stations
conventions.stress: per basis: axial N/A, bending My/Z and Mz/Z, torsion T*r_o/J (Pa); admitted bending over hull(Z-hat, I-hat/r_o)
conventions.circular_maximum: per basis: max over the two ends of |N|/A + hypot(My, Mz)/Z (an unloaded member's maximum is at an end)
conventions.support_reaction: support-on-pipe, global components; a spring's reaction is -k u on its DOF
conventions.readouts: annular: the engine's exact element; admitted: prepared binary64 leaves solved exactly

criterion.relative_limit: 1e-9 * |value| (REQ-001); an admitted interval row passes within 1e-9 of any point of the interval
criterion.discriminator_separation: |wrong - correct| / (1e-9 |correct|) >= 1e3 on every listed row; exact-zero rows are counted, not listed

cross_checks.per_solve: engine whole-body balance; equilibrium at every node and support DOF; member end statics; K_ff symmetric and positive definite; the unmutated annular element equals the engine's bit for bit
